newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude gets FTC request for information.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude gets FTC request for information.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said on Friday that it received a request from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission for more information related to the planned merger of Ventritex Inc into St. Jude's Pacesetter unit.
St. Jude said it and Ventritex are working to provide the FTC with the requested information. No further details were available.
Closing of the transaction is expected in the first quarter of 1997.

St. Jude and Ventritex said earlier this week that complaints were filed by Guidant Corp and Eli Lilly and Co related to St. Jude's deals to acquire Ventritex and the assets of Telectronics Pacing Systems Inc.

St. Jude also said on Friday that it completed the acquisition of substantially all the cardiac rhythm management assets of Telectronics Pacing. Telectronics Pacing is a subsidiary of Pacific Dunlop Ltd.
St. Jude said it also completed the acquisition of Medtel, an Asia-Pacific medical products distribution business that is related to Pacific Dunlop.
The Telectronics and Medtel deals were first announced in October.
